about_the_game:
Join a vibrant escape into the rhythm and colors of one of the world’s most iconic cities. While there's a light narrative thread that ties everything together, this game shines brightest as a joyful collection of hidden object challenges and engaging puzzles. It's less about following a plot, and more about getting lost in lively visuals, smart tasks, and the joy of discovery!

When young photographer Mimi Brooks heads to Rio de Janeiro, she brings her whole family along for an unforgettable Carnival-season vacation. With brother Bradley’s curiosity, their parents’ cultural interests, and Mimi’s ever-ready camera, the Brooks explore everything from sunlit beaches and colonial plazas to secret gardens and artistic enclaves. As they weave through Rio’s heart, every location tells a story of Brazilian spirit, history, and celebration — brought to life through the family's wide-eyed wonder.

Enjoy a colorful collection of puzzles ranging from classic hidden object scenes to creative mini-games. Each challenge is designed to test your logic, perception, and curiosity — no two scenes are the same!

Featuring:

🔎 Dozens of richly illustrated hidden object scenes packed with fun and surprises

🔎 Unique mini-games and clever puzzles for players of all experience levels

🔎 A cheerful tour of Rio’s culture, landmarks, and Carnival magic

🔎 Hidden collectibles waiting to be found across every scene

🔎 Bonus content: unlock beautiful wallpapers, concept art, and soundtrack excerpts

🔎 In-game achievements to celebrate your puzzle-solving progress

Can you uncover every treasure, solve every puzzle, and unlock the secret of the mysterious island? The journey awaits — let the festival begin!
